summary: Frontend-only PrintOrder app tested end-to-end: Home (alias + store code + quick pills + invalid error + barcode modal), StoreConfirm (store details + confirm), PrintSession (sample doc swap, copies stepper, color mode, scale steppers with 5 step + bounds, terms validation, task submission with toast + drawer, end session). Mobile viewport 390x844 renders without horizontal overflow. All data-testid selectors resolve. Price math verified: 8pg A4 BW 1x=Rp2.800, 2x=Rp5.600, color=Rp24.000.
passed: Quick store pill prefills kode toko input
Invalid store code shows home-error without navigation
Valid code navigates to /store-confirm/PO-GRAFIKA-01 with name/address/hours/services
btn-confirm-store creates session with #PO-xxxxx-X pattern and navigates to /session
sample-doc-select updates info-file-name, info-file-pages, info-estimated-price in realtime
Color mode 'Warna' recalculates to higher price (Rp24.000)
btn-scale-up/down adjust in steps of 5 and clamp at 200 upper bound
Submit without terms shows form-error 'Centang persetujuan syarat & ketentuan.'
Checked terms + submit creates task, opens drawer, shows task-success-toast with JOB-### id
btn-toggle-task-list reopens drawer with queued task
btn-end-session modal + btn-confirm-end clears session and navigates to /
Barcode scanner modal opens via btn-barcode-scan
Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390), scan button accessible
